name: PCL
description: Minecraft 启动器 Plain Craft Launcher（PCL）。
one_liner: A free, popular Minecraft game launcher (mainly used in China) that makes it easier to install, update, and run modded Minecraft.
buyer: Honestly, nobody pays for this — it's a donation-supported hobby project for Minecraft players, not a business tool. The closest thing to a 'buyer' is a Minecraft server community that benefits from easier player onboarding.
business_use_cases: A Minecraft server community (e.g. a Chinese gaming server) recommends it to members as the easiest way to join with the right mods pre-configured, reducing support tickets.
A Minecraft modpack creator bundles instructions around this launcher to lower the setup barrier for their modpack's audience.
A gaming content creator reviews or recommends it on video, picking up modest affiliate/sponsorship revenue unrelated to the launcher itself.

money_ideas.idea: Accept community donations (the project's own model, via 爱发电/afdian) rather than selling anything — this is the honest ceiling here.

steal_this: There isn't a real weekend business here — this is a passion project for Minecraft players, not a monetizable pain point. If anything, study how it earns community trust and donations as a pattern for other niche hobby tools.
